weakest_seam.instructions: Which secrecy seam in this design has the weakest executed evidence and most needs an additional probe before integration?

state: M1 secrecy boundary in assessment_profile.dispatch: (1) evidence_refs in any action must be members of the profile visible_observation_ids allowlist or the action is refused; (2) STEP views are materialized by policy_step.materialize_view which projects out sealed observations and strips sealed keys plus access labels; (3) any action requesting destination production under a non-production profile is refused; (4) propose_revision stages locally only, bind_revision requires trusted qualification plus exact candidate digest plus exact scope match; (5) nested assessment requests are refused beyond depth 1 and always under audit; (6) source digest is verified against the frozen candidate digest before any effect owner is called. Tests execute each refusal path and assert sealed literals never appear in materialized views. Legacy assessor untouched.
